race.comment: ATELLA MISS (6) has been building towards an overdue win and looks well placed to open her account here. She showed promise with a placing at Sale 2 starts ago before another honest effort at Geelong when coming to the end of her run late on a heavy track. The drop back to 1200m will suit her and she will be hard to hold out. MY ALPHA SONIC (4) returned with an encouraging performance for third at Wangaratta, finishing just over a length from the winner, and he should strip fitter second-up. He looms as one of the key dangers. LUNE LUMINEUSE (7) also makes her debut for the powerful Paddy Payne stable, and commands respect, while SAY IT HOW IT IS (8) resumes with a recent jump-out win under her belt, and she will be ready to rumble.
